text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p95 latency SLO breached for text-gen (prod, us-east) — automated routing fallback activity observed. SLO trigger count: 6 in last 5m. Paging oncall @tara.

tara: on it. seeing the same on dashboard — spikes align with reroute events. linking dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/latency/p95?env=prod&region=us-east

lucy-eng: fyi I can see a pattern where the router flips between primary-us-east and fallback-eu-west every ~30s. looks like cooldown/hysteresis isn't applied.

tara: checking routing policy for text-gen default route...

tara: config snippet:
```
route: text-gen-prod
primary: model:v2
fallbacks:
  - region: eu-west
    model: model:v2-quant
policy:
  p95_threshold_ms: 450
  cooldown_seconds: 0    # <<< suspicious
  evaluation_window: 60s
  hysteresis: 0.0        # <<< zero hysteresis
```

ben: not great — cooldown 0 and hysteresis 0 will make the router flip on any brief spike. did we recently push a policy change?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-06-14T02:14 by lucy-eng: routing/policy/text-gen updated (PR #2145).

lucy-eng: that PR accidentally removed the default cooldown (we intended 120s). my bad, rolling back now.

tara: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily set cooldown_seconds: 120 and hysteresis: 0.2 on text-gen route 2) pin region to us-east for heavy customers for 10m while we stabilize 3) notify CS and pause automated rollouts.

ben: agree. I'll make the policy change and apply a hotfix flag to disable automated fallback for that route.

ben: running CLI change:
```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --route text-gen-prod --policy '{"cooldown_seconds":120,"hysteresis":0.2}'
```

deploy-bot: Policy change applied (id: pol-9382). Rolling config to routers.

tara: verifying metrics... p95 is starting to come down, reroute count trending toward 0. still seeing elevated latency for a small cohort.

maria-cs: any user-facing impact? a few enterprise customers called in with higher-than-normal response times and a retry surge. put them in maintenance?

tara: for now we should add a targeted route pin for those customers. list from CS?

maria-cs: sending list: AcmeCorp, NimbusApps — they've seen 10-20% error/retry amplification.

ben: applying pin for AcmeCorp and NimbusApps to model:v2-primary in us-east for 30m:
```
redwoodctl routing pin --customer AcmeCorp --route text-gen-prod --model model:v2-primary --duration 1800
redwoodctl routing pin --customer NimbusApps --route text-gen-prod --model model:v2-primary --duration 1800
```

deploy-bot: Customer pins applied.

tara: p95 back to within SLO for global traffic. local tail still noisy for some customers but stable.

lucy-eng: root cause: PR removed cooldown/hysteresis in routing policy template, causing sensitive p95 triggers to immediately flip routes instead of waiting for sustained degradation. combined with prefix cache cold-starts in eu-west, each fallback made latency worse and triggered another fallback — positive feedback loop.

ben: postmortem action items (quick list):
- revert PR and add test coverage for routing policy defaults (lucy-eng)
- add backend guard: min_cooldown = 30s enforced on policy updates (sre)
- add circuit-breaker: avoid >3 reroutes per 10m per route (sre)
- customer impact follow-up with CS and support playbook (maria-cs)

tara: handing off to next oncall Ben for monitoring and follow-through. I'm going to sleep. good job team. :thumbsup:

ben: taking over. I'll leave a short incident summary in incidents log and kick off the postmortem doc.

maria-cs: sending customer comms template now. /cc @support to follow up with AcmeCorp & NimbusApps.

ben: final notes — root cause patch rolled back, temporary pins + cooldown/hysteresis applied. will keep automated fallback disabled for text-gen-prod for 1 hour while we validate. will open a full postmortem ticket (INC-2024-179).

incident-bot: Incident resolved: routing oscillation mitigated. Severity: S2 (customer-visible latency, limited scope). Timeline saved to incident-logs/2179990123.

lucy-eng: follow-up: I'll open PR to add linting to routing manifests and an integration test that simulates p95 flaps.

ben: thanks everyone. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
